what: Cognex makes machine vision: the cameras and software that let factory equipment see, reading barcodes, checking parts for defects and guiding robots.
customers: Logistics operators, carmakers, electronics manufacturers and consumer goods factories.
money: vision sensors and systems for inspection and guidance
barcode reading and dimensioning in warehouses
vision for chip and electronics manufacturing
moat: Vision algorithms tuned over thirty years and deployed in production lines where a false reject costs money, which makes customers reluctant to experiment with alternatives.
risks: Revenue fell from $1.0B to $838M in 2023 and has only partly recovered
33 times earnings for a business growing in the high single digits
Its three end markets, logistics, autos and electronics, have all been weak at once
opportunities: A 11.5% net margin and $286M of free cash flow, with $337M of cash against $77M of debt
Analysts see about 47% upside, with 20 covering the stock
Warehouse automation and electric vehicle battery inspection are both long-term demand sources
watch: Logistics segment revenue and overall bookings growth.
